description: Creates one antiRea signal instance (from @dannyphan190/anti-rea) and holds it in an in-memory session. kind is one of the 8 from list_signals. options are forwarded verbatim to the library factory - seat-occupancy and room-guard REQUIRE options { capacity: number }; for all other kinds options may be omitted (lab-frozen defaults - do not retune silently). Returns the sessionId to feed with observe.

options.description: Factory options, forwarded verbatim (seat-occupancy and room-guard: { capacity } is required).

sessionId.description: Caller-chosen session id. Omit to have the server generate one.

name: create_signal
title: Create a signal session
